q: Cuturi's Sinkhorn algorithm for regularised optimal transport (with entropy regularisation ε·H(γ)) converges to the solution of:
opts: min_{γ∈Π(μ,ν)} ∫c dγ − ε·H(γ) (entropy-regularised OT), converging to the unregularised solution as ε → 0
exp: Sinkhorn iterations solve the entropy-regularised OT: min_γ {∫c dγ − ε·H(γ)}. The solution is a matrix proportional to e^{-c/ε} diag(u) diag(v)^T; Sinkhorn rescales rows and columns alternately. As ε → 0, the solution converges to the unregularised OT (Brenier map). Sinkhorn runs in O(n²) iterations.
